    • useCardTypeInProject

      @PUT @Path("useCardTypeInProject/{cardTypeId: [0-9]+}/{projectId: [0-9]+}") public AbstractCardType useCardTypeInProject(@PathParam("cardTypeId") Long cardTypeId, @PathParam("projectId") Long projectId)
      If the card type is not already in the project, create a reference to it. Else simply return the card type.
      Parameters:
      cardTypeId - the id of the target card type (or reference)
      projectId - the id of the project in which we want to use the card type
      Returns:
      The card type

    • removeCardTypeRefFromProject

      @PUT @Path("removeCardTypeFromProject/{cardTypeId: [0-9]+}/{projectId: [0-9]+}") public void removeCardTypeRefFromProject(@PathParam("cardTypeId") Long cardTypeRefId, @PathParam("projectId") Long projectId)
      Remove the card type use of the project. That means delete the reference in the project if it has no use. If the abstract card type is used, throws an error.
      Parameters:
      cardTypeRefId - the id of the card type reference no more useful for the project
      projectId - the id of the project in which we don't want to use the card type anymore
